action_phrases.structure: anticipation -> action (twos, or ones for impacts <= 8f) -> settle

cues.addressing: absolute integer frame number from cut start; seconds-based cue times are rejected by the validator
cues.background_switch: lands on the first frame of the beat it belongs to, verified on rendered frames by timing_check.py

mouth.order: afureko: voice take is fixed to the locked animatic first, flaps are fitted to the voice after

source: Pokemon TV production spec gap analysis, report.md section 10 (timing rules), encoded as pipeline defaults 2026-10-28
